title: Motion Tracking & Thermal Studies
summary: Developing 2D tracking and stereo reconstruction workflows for soft robotic motion, alongside fabrication of cavity-size variants for digital-composite heating studies.
contribution: Marker tracking, camera calibration, fixture evaluation, mold CAD, and specimen fabrication.
evidence: Tracking comparisons, stereo fixture results, and a research poster. New-specimen thermal testing remains pending.
alt: Reconstructed three-dimensional coordinates of the stereo evaluation fixture

title: Computational Materials for Quantum Technologies
summary: First-principles investigation of point defects in cubic beryllium sulfide using DFT, GW, and BSE methods to study electronic structure, stability, and optical excitations.
contribution: Analysis of defect structures and electronic and optical behavior, interpretation of results, and research presentation.
evidence: Defect visualizations, optical spectra, and the research poster.
alt: Crystal structure from the cubic BeS point-defect study

title: Hybrid Fiber-Reinforced Polymer Composites
summary: Fabrication and characterization of jute, E-glass, and hybrid epoxy composites through tensile, flexural, and dynamic mechanical testing.
contribution: Laminate fabrication, specimen preparation, mechanical and dynamic testing, and analysis of material response.
evidence: Specimen photographs and DMA comparisons across the three composite systems.
alt: Composite specimens from the jute, glass, and hybrid study
